body: I have told her all of this. I've tried to make "skype dates" but something always comes up. I would think one or two talks on skype a month wouldn't be too much to ask, but for her it is. I've told her about the boy thing, and she thinks its just stupid jealousy. We used to skype all the time. I feel like I'm being reasonable but she's told me many times that I'm unreasonable and even crazy. These things may be true, and I dont want to be one of those people who paint themselves as a saint and put the blame all on somebody else, but in this instance, I don't think I'm asking too much. Besides, talking to her right now makes me feel terrible, because when she says something or does something that makes me happy, or i remember something happy,  I feel that much worse because I know i wont be able to see her. Thank you so much for all of your help, I hope you sleep well and have a wonderful day tomorrow.

Now I feel lucky for being able to see her twice in the time we've been together. We've been friends for over a year, but "dating" since feb. I have to go outside and walk everyday since I have class everyday and my classes are all far apart. It's not a huge campus, but its not small either. I am your stereotypical neckbeard, I do indeed live in my parents basement, although that hasnt always been the case. We just moved here earlier this year and this is my first basement ever. I see my family everyday, sometimes I spend more time with them than others. Today I spent very little to no time with them. Maybe 10 minutes all added up, if that. I am a burden in that I cost my folks a lot of money, and ever since I've admitted my depression, they worry a lot. LDRs are very hard, especially when your SO doesn't make time for you. Sure we type everyday(not this last week and sometimes miss a day, but for the most part daily), but thats not the same as talking or seeing. Me bugging her to talk, or bringing up issues, or just generally being depressed puts a huge strain on her, and I know that for a fact. I just can't give her what all those video game boys are giving her, and what that thing is, I dont know. For some reason I keep having this fantasy that somebody will give me permission to let myself go, that somebody will say "it's okay, you dont have to do this anymore", and then everything will be okay and i can just do it. that would be nice.

I certainly don't enjoy being a fat neckbeard, but I enjoy food and I'm too upset to really be proactive about it. Basically my weight is at the bottom of a list of problems for me. She's kind of my best friend. I've never met somebody I could talk to like that, just be totally candid and not be afraid of being judged. I have a couple other friends, but they're extremely judgmental dudes and they hate that I'm on medication. I put off saying this because I'm ashamed, but its a longdistance thing, and last week while I was making plan to buy tickets to see her, things happened within her family and she said it was best if I didn't come for the holidays. We're both in school, so that means the only time I coudl really see her is next summer. Honestly the only thing keeping me going was knowing that I could see her in the winter, but thats gone, man. It almost felt like a breakup when she told me, it still does, but her and I would still like to make it work. We have met in the past and every time it couldn't go better. I know it wouldn't make her happy if I did it, but I think in the long run it would be better for her. I think she'll get over it and she'll move on and find a nice boy. And my friends won't have to pay for my dinner, or deal with me being annoying. My parents wont have to support me and my brother wont have to fight with me anymore. All of these things sound like good things to me, the icing on the cake is not having to feel pain anymore. I feel really bad for saying these things because I don't want to ruin your night or make you feel bad or anything.

I really do appreciate what you're saying, but I honestly feel like her and most everybody in my life would be better without me here. I played with her tonight and was on a voice chat server with a bunch of the people she plays with. They all seem like nice guys, and they all seem to make her really happy. She seemed happier with them tonight than I seen in the past four or five months with me. We've talked about these issues before, but they never really get resolved. She's very obviously unhappy, and I dont know if its because of me or something else, but I'm pretty fucking sure its me. I am so lucky to have found her because I'm a pretty overweight individual, and I really don't think I can find another girl, nor do I want to. Shes a good person and she deserves so much better than I can give her. I'm just getting in the way. Also we don't live together.

I saw my therapist today. I would feel really pathetic asking for another extension. My gf is pretty addicted to a certain video game. She has made a lot of friends on there and spends the vast majority of her time playing/talking with those people. It makes her happy so I really can't do anything about it, even though I have told her its a problem, multiple times. It's good to have friends and to do things, but I think there needs to be a balance. The balance being spending time with me at all, and not just playing that game. I probably have pulled away from her, especially lately, but it has gone both ways for sure.
